summary: Independently re-ran npm test (270 pass, 0 fail, 2 todo), npm run test:browser (28 subtests, both 360 and 1280 px, pass), and syntax check plus frontend unit tests (5 pass). Submitted artifact hashes match the files on disk. The UI meets the phase acceptance criteria and the spec section 7 contracts; remaining items are minor.

criteria.description: Screens and states (sign in, incidents, notes, generate, review, publish, postmortems) with loading, empty, error, success
Citation highlight, Not grounded with reasons, Publish disabled while flagged, fallback banner, spec 7.3 test ids
Accessibility and responsive: keyboard, focus outline >= 2px, skip link, live regions, contrast, 44px targets, no overflow at 360
XSS safety and CSP conformance: textContent only, no inline script/style
Browser journey passes at both widths with screenshots; fails rather than skips without Chromium

findings.title: Escape-returns-focus-to-chip is implemented but not asserted
findings.detail: Spec 7.1 requires Escape in the source panel to return focus to the opening chip. source.js handles it, but journey.test.js contains no Escape assertion.
findings.recommendation: Add an Escape step to the chip test; resolved when the test asserts focus returns to the chip.

findings.title: Entry file is app.js, not js/main.js as written in spec 7
findings.detail: Structure differs from the spec filename only; behaviour and the router/store contract are met. index.html loads /app.js consistently.
findings.recommendation: Note the filename in the spec or README; no code change needed.
